name: HotelPreArrivalUpsellManager
tagline: Sell more upgrades and add-ons before guests arrive – with inventory and approvals under control.
description: A complete hotel pre-arrival upsell app for Power Apps and Power Pages: revenue dashboard and funnel, pipeline board with allowed transitions, offers list with bulk send and approve, an upsell inventory calendar by night, offer catalogue, approval limits and offer cutoff rules. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped and connects to any table in a few clicks.
features: Offer catalogue with per-night or per-stay pricing
Room-upgrade, early check-in and late checkout inventory per night
Manager approval limit and optional auto-approve
Offer cutoff and send window rules
Bulk send / approve / expire / assign / export
Conversion by channel and revenue by offer type
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
